lake-como-hotels-ranked.title: Lake Como hotels FAQ
faq: What is the best luxury hotel on Lake Como?

My favorite is Grand Hotel Tremezzo: the 1910 landmark in the middle of the lake, looking straight across at Bellagio, with five restaurants and some of the best rooms on Como. It’s the most fun hotel on the lake and the best located. Il Sereno is a very close second, and the best true lakefront hotel.
What is the best Lake Como hotel for a honeymoon?

Passalacqua. It’s a 1787 villa in Moltrasio with just 24 rooms, and only hotel guests can use the restaurants and spa, so it feels genuinely exclusive. The honeymoon I’d book is two nights at Passalacqua and two at Il Sereno, ten minutes apart by private boat. See the pairing.
Which Lake Como hotel is right on the water?

Il Sereno. It sits right on the water in Torno and every room looks at the lake. Book the Grand Suite for the head-on view and a private terrace. Passalacqua is a terraced garden property, so most rooms see the lake in the distance rather than up close.
Where should I stay on Lake Como with kids?

Grand Hotel Tremezzo, my pick for families, with three pools and plenty of space. The two-bedroom suite at the Lake Como EDITION is also good value for a family. Il Sereno is built for couples and isn’t a family hotel.
Which Lake Como hotel is best for tennis?

Villa d’Este, with eight clay courts. It’s the best hotel on the lake for a tennis trip with friends, especially paired with one of the estate’s private villas. Grand Hotel Tremezzo also has a clay court.
Villa d’Este or Villa Serbelloni?

Villa d’Este. Service is polished and warm, the gardens are beautiful, and Cernobbio puts a town at your door about an hour from Milan. Villa Serbelloni wins for swimming, with a pool, a beach and a floating pier, and its spa is stunning, but the decor is a bit too old for my taste and Bellagio is very crowded. The full head-to-head.
Is it worth staying in Bellagio?

Only if you’re set on it. Bellagio is packed with day-trippers in high season, and it was crowded even in October. You can visit easily by boat from anywhere on the lake. If you do stay, Villa Serbelloni is the hotel, at the water’s edge.
Which part of Lake Como is best to stay in?

Mid-lake, around Tremezzo and Cadenabbia, for the best location and views across to Bellagio. Cernobbio, home to Villa d’Este, if you want restaurants and shops within walking distance and a short drive from Milan. Torno (Il Sereno) and Moltrasio (Passalacqua) if you want it quiet.
How do I get from Milan to my Lake Como hotel?

For the hotels near the town of Como, like Villa d’Este and Il Sereno, a private car from Milan, about an hour. For the hotels farther up the lake, like Grand Hotel Tremezzo, the EDITION and Villa Serbelloni, a private car to Como and then a private boat to the hotel’s dock. I arrange both.

santorini-hotels-ranked.title: Santorini hotels FAQ
faq: What is the best hotel in Santorini?

Canaves Oia Suites. It was recently completely renovated, sits higher on the Caldera than most, so you get more privacy, every room has coverings above the outdoor spaces, and it has the best spa on the Caldera. Canaves Epitome makes an excellent case for #1 too, and it was my favorite hotel across nine islands.
What is the best Santorini hotel for a honeymoon?

The top tier is Canaves Oia Suites, Andronis Boutique, Andronis Luxury Suites and Canaves Ena, and the difference between them is minuscule. Younger couples who want the classic cave room usually love Andronis Boutique. Couples 50+ or returning for an anniversary tend to prefer Andronis Luxury Suites.
Should I stay in Oia or Imerovigli?

For most first-timers, Oia. At the top Oia hotels no one walks directly in front of your room, while several Imerovigli hotels sit right on the Fira-to-Oia walking path. Imerovigli does have something Oia doesn’t: at Grace you’re sometimes literally above the fog line. If privacy matters, say so when booking and I’ll pick the room.
Which Santorini hotel is best for families?

Canaves Epitome, with no age restrictions and two-bedroom suites separated by floor with large pools. Andronis Arcadia is the resort option, with 114 rooms, all with private pools. Note that Canaves Oia Suites has a 13+ age requirement.
Which Santorini hotel has the best sunset?
Canaves Epitome, near Ammoudi Bay. You watch an actual sunset into the Aegean rather than the sun disappearing behind the Caldera. Andronis Arcadia, next door, also has beautiful sunset-facing rooms.
What is the most private hotel in Santorini?

Complete privacy doesn’t exist anywhere on the Caldera. Canaves Oia Suites and Canaves Ena sit higher on the Caldera, which means more privacy, and Oia Suites covers every outdoor space. For complete privacy, Canaves Epitome, a short walk from Oia behind volcanic-rock walls, is the answer.
Which Santorini hotel has the best spa?
Andronis Concept has the nicest spa I saw on Santorini, maybe in the Cyclades. On the Caldera itself, the brand-new spa at Canaves Oia Suites is the best.
Canaves or Andronis?

Both portfolios sit at the top of my list. Canaves Oia Suites is the caldera, perfected, with the best spa. Andronis Boutique is the cave room people picture, and every Andronis room has a plunge pool or jacuzzi, which isn’t the case at Canaves. My full Canaves vs. Andronis comparison.
Is Katikies worth it?

Katikies holds some of the most storied real estate on Santorini and the spa at Pelagos House is impressive, but the interiors haven’t kept pace with the island’s recent renovations and the patios have no coverings. For now my clients usually find stronger value a notch up this list. Katikies vs. Canaves Oia Suites.

best-hotels-greece.title: Greece hotels FAQ
faq: What is the best luxury hotel in Greece?

Canaves Epitome in Santorini, the single best hotel I experienced across the 38 I visited, and perhaps one of the top three stays of my life. It sits a short walk from Oia near Ammoudi Bay rather than on the Caldera, with the best sunset in Greece and the best hotel restaurant I ate at all trip.
What is the best hotel in Greece for a honeymoon?

Gundari on Folegandros, 27 suites and villas with endless ocean views and private plunge pools, for couples who want remote and quiet. For the classic caldera honeymoon, Canaves Oia Suites. For ten nights, I’d book Mykonos, then Folegandros, then Santorini.
Which Greek islands should I visit on a first trip?

For seven nights, Mykonos and Santorini: fly into Mykonos, take the ferry south, and save Athens for another trip. Mykonos is easy to reach from Europe and the Middle East. If you’ve already done Santorini, Folegandros and Paros are the quiet side of the Cyclades.
How many Greek islands can I do in one trip?
I cap clients at two islands per week. Never book the last ferry of the day, and know that fast ferries cancel in meltemi winds. The five ferry rules I give every couple.
What are the best luxury hotels in Mykonos?

Bill & Coo Coast, adults-only on a protected bay with a private beach club. Kalesma, above Ornos Bay, for couples. Cali, on the quieter east side, with the best hotel gym I’ve ever seen. Kalesma vs. Cali.
What is the best hotel in Paros?

Parilio, just outside Naoussa, for design lovers, and its new hilltop villas for families and groups. Cosme, walking distance to Naoussa with a private beach club, for laid-back beach luxury. And no, Paros is not “the new Mykonos.” Naoussa is lively without the flashy scene.
Which Greek hotels are best for families and groups?
Parilio’s three-bedroom villas on Paros, which run around $3,000 to $3,500 per night in peak season with full access to the hotel, paired with Canaves Epitome in Santorini, which has no age limits.
When is the best time to visit Greece?
May or September to October. It’s the same hotels at dramatically better pricing, and the pools are quieter. In July, expect kids at the pool even at the hotels that feel calm in shoulder season.
Can I take a helicopter between the Greek islands?
Yes, and it’s one of the most common upgrades I arrange. A helicopter can turn a half-day ferry into a 20-minute flight, and skips the wind delays and crowded terminals. My partnership with Hoper.
Why aren’t Crete or One&Only Kea on this list?

I didn’t visit them on this trip. This list covers the 38 hotels I stayed at or toured across seven islands in the Cyclades, so it’s my ten favorites from what I’ve seen in person, not every luxury hotel in the country.
Does it cost more to book Greek hotels through you?
No. Rates through me are identical to booking direct, and Fora preferred partner amenities, like space-available upgrades, daily breakfast and hotel credits, come on top.

dolomites-hotels.title: Dolomites hotels FAQ
faq: What is the best luxury hotel in the Dolomites?

It depends on why you’re going. Forestis is my personal favorite, for the spa, the views and the quiet. Gardena Grödnerhof is a close second and the best base. Aman Rosa Alpina is the most luxurious stay in the region.
What is the best Dolomites hotel for a honeymoon?
Forestis, high above Bressanone with the best view of the Odle of any luxury hotel in the region. It won my categories for wellness, privacy, views, dining and service. It’s adults 14 and over.
Which Dolomites hotel is ski-in, ski-out?

COMO Alpina, on the Alpe di Siusi, is the only true ski-in, ski-out hotel on my list. Aman Rosa Alpina is about two minutes from the lifts by shuttle, and Gardena Grödnerhof is close to them in Ortisei.
Where should I stay in the Dolomites for hiking?

Ortisei, at Gardena Grödnerhof, with lifts to two completely different areas: Seceda for the dramatic peaks of Val Gardena, and the gondola to the meadows of the Alpe di Siusi. At COMO Alpina you walk out of your room onto the trails. Forestis is not a hiking base.
Which Dolomites hotel is best for families?
Gardena Grödnerhof, COMO Alpina and Aman Rosa Alpina. Forestis is adults 14 and over, though families can book the five-bedroom Forestis Villa.
When is the best time to visit the Dolomites?

September and early October are my favorite: quieter trails, crisp clear days and, by mid-October, golden larches. Late June to mid-September is peak hiking season and peak crowds, with afternoon thunderstorms in July and August. Many hotels and lifts close roughly April to May and from late October or November into December, so check before you set dates.
What is the closest airport to the Dolomites?

Innsbruck, about two hours from Ortisei or Forestis. Verona is about two and a half hours, and Venice, Munich and Milan are about three to four. By train, get off at Bolzano for Ortisei, the Alpe di Siusi or Merano, or at Bressanone for Forestis, and finish by private car.
Should I split my Dolomites trip between two hotels?

Yes, it gives you two very different stays, and most drives between them are about an hour. My favorite is two or three nights at Gardena Grödnerhof in Ortisei, then two or three at Forestis. Venice, at Airelles Palladio, is two and a half to three hours away for the start or finish.
Do I need a car in the Dolomites?

I’d use a private driver instead. Mountain passes are narrow and winding, parking in Ortisei is tight in summer, and the road up the Alpe di Siusi is restricted to permit holders. I arrange drivers, lift times, mountain guides and helicopters.
What are the sauna rules at Dolomites hotels?

The main sauna areas are mixed, men and women together. You walk around the spa in a towel or robe, but swimsuits come off in the saunas and steam rooms, and you sit or lie on your towel. The culture is German and Austrian and applies at every hotel on this list. The pools are swimsuit areas.

napa-sonoma.title: Napa & Sonoma hotels FAQ
faq: What is the best luxury hotel in Napa Valley?

Meadowood. Service is at Aman standards, it has a real sense of place, and with around 40 spacious cottages there really isn’t a bad room. Four Seasons Napa Valley is my #2. Meadowood vs. Four Seasons.
What is the best Napa or Sonoma hotel for a honeymoon?
Meadowood is the honeymoon splurge. For a romantic weekend with beautiful design, Madrona Manor in Healdsburg feels more like someone’s estate than a hotel. It’s a couples property.
Should I stay in Napa or Sonoma?

Napa has Meadowood, Four Seasons and Solage. Sonoma County has Montage Healdsburg, Madrona Manor and MacArthur Place, and downtown Sonoma is quaint, local and less commercialized than Healdsburg. My full Napa vs. Sonoma comparison.
What is the best hotel in Healdsburg?

Montage Healdsburg. I’ve stayed at least 20 times. It’s just outside downtown with a complimentary shuttle to the plaza, and I prefer the vineyard rooms. Madrona Manor is a few minutes from the plaza by e-bike.
Which wine country hotel is best for families?
Four Seasons Napa Valley fits families, multi-generational trips and groups best. Solage and Carneros work well too. I wouldn’t recommend Madrona Manor for families.
Which Napa or Sonoma hotel can you walk to town from?
MacArthur Place is the easiest, right next to downtown Sonoma. Alila Napa Valley is a few minutes on foot from downtown St. Helena, which is rare in the valley.
Which wine country hotel is best for a girls trip or weekend with friends?
Solage Calistoga, which is relaxed rather than white-glove, with private gardens or terraces in most rooms. Four Seasons Napa Valley also works well for girls trips and multi-couple groups.
Is Stanly Ranch worth it?

Stanly Ranch might be the most architecturally striking hotel on this list, with arguably the prettiest spa and terraces with fire pits. The catch is the location: it sits out in the marshes and doesn’t deliver the classic wine country feeling. Carneros vs. Stanly Ranch.

the-fifteen.title: Honeymoon hotels FAQ
faq: What are the best honeymoon hotels in the world?

My fifteen span Greece, Italy, the Maldives, Hawaii and Napa & Sonoma. Each one I’ve either visited or booked repeatedly, and each is right for a different kind of couple, so it’s a shortlist rather than a ranking.
What is the best honeymoon hotel in Greece?

Canaves Epitome in Santorini for the modern caldera icon, Kalesma in Mykonos for design and calm, Gundari on Folegandros for no crowds, and Parilio on Paros for relaxed luxury. My full Greece ranking.
What is the best honeymoon hotel in Italy?
Passalacqua on Lake Como, Il San Pietro di Positano on the Amalfi Coast, Borgo Egnazia in Puglia and Grand Hotel Timeo in Taormina.
What is the best honeymoon resort in the Maldives?
Soneva Jani for overwater villas with retractable roofs, Joali Being for a wellness-first, restorative honeymoon, and Cheval Blanc Randheli for the most polished service in the atolls.
What is the best honeymoon hotel in Hawaii?
Four Seasons Hualalai on the Big Island, the benchmark for service, or Four Seasons Resort Lanai, remote, private and unmatched for couples.
How do I choose between these honeymoon hotels?
Pick two or three that appeal and tell me why. The reasons behind the choice tell me far more than the list itself, and usually point to a fourth property you haven’t heard of.

top-hotel-pools.title: Hotel pools FAQ
faq: Which hotels have the most beautiful pools in the world?
My top three are Miramalfi, carved into the cliffside in Amalfi, Le Sirenuse, with its rooftop pool over Positano, and Amangiri, built into a red rock mesa in the Utah desert.
Which Italian hotel has the best pool?

Miramalfi and Le Sirenuse on the Amalfi Coast, and on Lake Como, Mandarin Oriental, with an infinity pool at the water’s edge framed by the Alps. In the Dolomites, Miramonti above Merano has the best outdoor pool I saw. My Dolomites ranking.
Which Santorini hotel has the best pool?

The River Suite at Canaves Oia Suites, a private cave pool running out through an arch to the caldera. For a shared pool, Grace’s cascading infinity pools hang over the caldera. Elsewhere in Greece, Gundari on Folegandros has the coolest infinity pool in the Cyclades.
Which French Riviera hotels have the best pools?
Hôtel du Cap-Eden-Roc, with the legendary pool blasted into the cliffs, Hotel Cap Estel, jutting into the sea on its own peninsula, and Zannier Hôtels, Île de Bendor, on a private island.
Which hotel pool is best for sunset?
Six Senses Ibiza, a cliffside infinity pool built for sunset.

top-hotel-tennis-courts.title: Hotel tennis FAQ
faq: Which hotels have the most beautiful tennis courts in the world?

My top two are both in Italy: Il San Pietro di Positano, a turf court blasted into the cliffside above the Amalfi Coast, and Hotel Cipriani, a private clay court on Giudecca framed by the Venetian lagoon.
What are the best tennis hotels in Italy?
Il San Pietro and Hotel Cipriani, plus Passalacqua and Villa d’Este on Lake Como and Splendido above Portofino’s harbor.
Where can I play tennis on Lake Como?

Villa d’Este has eight clay courts and is the best hotel on the lake for a tennis trip with friends. Passalacqua has a single clay court above the lake, and Grand Hotel Tremezzo has one too. My Lake Como ranking.
Which hotel has an indoor tennis court?
Bürgenstock Resort on Lake Lucerne, an alpine indoor court wrapped in timber below the peaks.
Which tennis resort has the most courts?
Mauna Kea Beach Hotel, Hawaii’s original tennis park, with a dozen courts along the Kohala Coast. Gstaad Palace has clay courts that host an annual stop on the pro tour.
Is there a good tennis hotel in Napa Valley?
Meadowood. Its tennis facility is underrated, with beautiful courts and instructors I’d recommend in a heartbeat. My Napa & Sonoma ranking.
